# FMI 2.0 headers

`fmi2Functions.h`, `fmi2FunctionTypes.h` and `fmi2TypesPlatform.h` are the
headers of the FMI Standard 2.0.4, unchanged except for line endings (CRLF to
LF):

- source: https://github.com/modelica/fmi-standard, tag `v2.0.4`
  (commit `2da4b9a57e668cfde168bec6fca3ac0773dc47e6`), directory `headers/`;
- license: BSD 2-Clause, Modelica Association Project "FMI" (`LICENSE.txt`).

`LICENSE.txt` keeps the part of the standard's license that covers these
headers. The rest of that file is about the specification document, which is
not included here.
